# Arsenic — thermal source review and remaining gap

<!-- generated-by: sync-thermochemistry.mjs -->

**Heat-capacity fit: INSUFFICIENT DATA in this accession.** The search result is source-specific and does not establish that measurements are absent from the scientific literature. No heat-capacity curve or calculated thermodynamic table has been generated from it.

[Parent record](0033-Arsenic-As.md) · [Structured review](data/structured/0033-Arsenic-As-Thermochemistry-Source-Review.yaml)

## Sources checked

- **SRC-000351:** [NIST Chemistry WebBook, elemental As](https://webbook.nist.gov/cgi/cbook.cgi?ID=C7440382&Mask=FFFF), retrieved 2026-10-05. The retained page has no Shomate heat-capacity table. [Exact downloaded page](../../data/catalog/sources/nist-thermochemistry-0033-2026-10-05.html.txt).
- **SRC-000341:** [NIST-JANAF PDF catalogue](https://janaf.nist.gov/janaf4pdf.html), retrieved 2026-09-29. Its Arsenic cell is unlinked and marked inactive. This records the coverage of this dated index. [Exact downloaded index](../../data/catalog/sources/nist-thermochemistry-janaf-index-2026-09-29.html.txt).

Both files retain their original bytes, byte counts and SHA-256 hashes in the structured review. Existing parent-record density and melting/boiling references are preserved; they do not supply a heat-capacity function.

## Next source review

Review primary elemental heat-capacity measurements or a separate assessed thermodynamic source. Verify phase, molar basis, temperature, uncertainty and licence before accession. Do not substitute compound data. Record experimental method, sample purity, phase, temperature/pressure range, stated uncertainty and any reference-state conversions. A compound containing Arsenic has a different molar basis and must not be substituted for elemental As. Heat capacity, standard entropy, enthalpy increments and their uncertainties remain UNKNOWN in this supplement until an applicable source is accepted. Wider thermal completion remains pending.

sources.scope: Retained elemental As page has no Shomate heat-capacity table. Reaction thermochemistry and gas-phase ion energetics are separate data classes, not a heat-capacity function. Together with the separately dated SRC-000341 JANAF PDF index inactive cell, this records a bounded source-availability gap, not absence of elemental measurements elsewhere. No coefficient, heat-capacity curve, zero value or other numeric property is accessioned by this review.
